Scoring Weapon and <arc/>Arc-Powered Melee Kills build up 'Jetpack Fuel'. Weapon kills grant 15% energy, and <arc/>Arc-Melee kills grant 35% energy. Jetpack Fuel additionally builds at a passive rate of 3.5% per second.

Once Jetpack Fuel is fully charged, pressing [Air Move] input while airborne thrusts you forward in a jet-propelled flight for 30 meters for 1.5 seconds. Holding down the input results in a 100% longer flight duration, traveling 50 meters over 3 seconds.

Jetpack Activation deals <pve 168 /> <pvp [69] /> <arc/>Arc Damage in a 6 meter radius and applies Exhaust.

Colliding with an enemy while flying triggers a <arc/>Melee Strike for <pve 336 /> <pvp [?] /> <arc/>Arc Damage, <arc/>Blinds targets in a ? meter radius, and grants 40 Melee stat for 7 seconds.
